message.content: An idempotent operation is one that can be applied multiple times without changing the result beyond the initial application.
message.reasoning_content:
*   Question: "In one sentence, what does 'idempotent' mean?"
    *   Constraint: One sentence.
    *   Context: Likely programming/mathematics/API design.

    *   Mathematical definition: An operation that can be applied multiple times without changing the result beyond the initial application.
    *   Programming/API definition: An operation that has no additional effect if it is called more than once with the same input parameters.

    *   *Draft 1:* An idempotent operation is one that can be applied multiple times without changing the result beyond the initial application. (Good, standard)
    *   *Draft 2:* In computing, idempotency means that performing an operation multiple times yields the same result as performing it once. (Clear, concise)
    *   *Draft 3:* An idempotent action is one where repeated executions produce the same state as a single execution. (Accurate)

    *   "An idempotent operation is one that can be applied multiple times without changing the result beyond the initial application."
